DgH7JF3Gy24.text: Home Reels Messages Search Notifications Create Dashboard Profile More Also from Meta dryeaesthetics Follow dryeaesthetics 3d Facial Lift • Facial Rejuvenation • Jawline | 68-year-old — It’s Never Too Late to Do Something for Yourself. Two years ago, she came to me seeking facial rejuvenation. At 68, a woman can embrace her age and still want to feel beautiful. Accepting the passage of time doesn’t mean giving up the desire for change. For many women considering surgery, the excitement of a possible transformation often comes with concerns about safety, recovery, and whether the results will look natural. As her doctor, my assessment focused on several interconnected areas of facial aging: • Eyelid laxity, under-eye bags and tear troughs • Descending midface tissues and reduced cheek support • Deep nasolabial folds and marionette lines • Prominent jowls and loss of jawline definition • Submental and neck laxity With my patented Tri-Vector Lift™ approach, I focus on repositioning descended tissues, restoring structural support, and improving overall facial harmony. Everyone ages differently. Even patients of the same age may have significantly different degrees of tissue descent, volume loss, and skin laxity. That’s why every treatment plan must be individually designed. As her recovery progressed, her cheeks appeared more defined, facial folds softened, and her jawline and chin-to-neck transition became clearer. What matters to me as a doctor is not simply how much younger a patient looks, but whether the improvement aligns with her expectations. At 68, beauty is not about competing with younger women. It’s about enjoying the years ahead on your own terms. I’m Dr. Ye. My team provides personalized treatment planning, translation support throughout your stay, and postoperative guidance.
